# Backend_App (S3-01a) — Python dependency manifest for the FastAPI shell.
#
# Scope: this file declares exactly what the Backend_App container / dev venv
# needs to run FastAPI over HTTP with an auto-generated OpenAPI schema
# (Requirements 2.1, 2.2). The API delegates every operation to the frozen
# S2-08 Decision_Service (`pipeline.service`) and adds NO decision logic of its
# own (Requirement 2.4, combined-sprint AC4).
#
# Python: 3.13 only (>=3.13,<3.14), inherited from the repo-root pyproject.toml
# / requirements.txt. The engine (numpy/shapely/geopandas) must not run on 3.14
# — see the repo-root requirements.txt for why. Keep this pinned to 3.13.

# --- Web transport layer -----------------------------------------------------
# FastAPI: the ASGI web framework. It auto-generates the OpenAPI schema at
# /openapi.json (+ /docs, /redoc) that satisfies the S2-08 machine-readable
# contract requirement (Requirement 2.2).
fastapi==0.115.6
# Uvicorn (with the [standard] extras: uvloop, httptools, websockets, watchfiles
# for --reload) is the ASGI server used to run the app in dev and in the
# container: `uvicorn app:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000` (Requirement 5.1).
uvicorn[standard]==0.34.0

# --- Decision engine (`pipeline.service`) — made importable, NOT listed here --
# The Backend_App IMPORTS and DELEGATES to the pure operation functions in
# pipeline/service/ so `import pipeline.service` must resolve at runtime. The
# engine is deliberately NOT declared as an installable/editable dependency in
# this manifest because the repo-root pyproject.toml declares [project] metadata
# only — it has no [build-system] and no package discovery, so `pip install -e`
# cannot build the `pipeline` package. Instead the engine is made importable by
# putting the repo root on the import path:
#
#   * In the container (app/api/Dockerfile, task 7.1): the `pipeline/` package is
#     copied into the image and the repo root is on PYTHONPATH (ENV PYTHONPATH).
#   * In dev (Requirement 5.1): run uvicorn from `app/api/` with the repo root on
#     PYTHONPATH (e.g. `PYTHONPATH=../.. uvicorn app:app --reload --port 8000`),
#     mirroring how the repo's own pytest suite imports `pipeline` today.
#
# The engine's own runtime dependencies (pandas, geopandas, shapely, rasterio,
# …) come from the repo-root requirements.txt, which the Dockerfile installs
# before this manifest. If a build-system + package discovery are later added to
# pyproject.toml, this can become a proper editable install (`-e <repo-root>`)
# and the PYTHONPATH shims can be dropped — a repo-root change, tracked
# separately from this task.
